historic_survey.note: The Pacific Heights Townhouses by Daniel Solomon, built as a demonstration that the new 1978 residential rezoning could allow denser development than the rules it replaced. Wood shingle siding, large gridded bay windows and a mid-block open space drawn from historical precedent rather than a rear-yard setback; published on the cover of Progressive Architecture in October 1979.
